name: Levites
overview: The Levites were divinely set apart as ministers of religion, distinct from the other tribes of Israel, with Aaron and his sons consecrated to the priestly office as a perpetual statute (Exodus 28:1; 29:9). Their zealous loyalty to God was demonstrated when they rallied to Moses' side during the crisis of idolatry, executing judgment against those who turned from the LORD (Exodus 32:26-28). The Levites were also entrusted with cities and houses throughout the land, which they could redeem at any time, highlighting their unique role and provision within Israel (Leviticus 25:32).
